thesis: STAAR Surgical is the global leader in phakic Implantable Collamer Lenses (the EVO ICL family), with 4M+ lenses sold worldwide. After a brutal FY2025 (revenue -23.7% to $239.44M, net loss -$80.45M, ~-$1.68/share), the turnaround is now materializing: China refractive demand stabilized through 2025 and rebounded strongly in Q1 2026, driving a return to profitability and pushing TTM revenue back to +4.0% (~$290.4M). Preliminary Q1 and Q2 2026 net sales each came in above $90M, led by China and broader Asia-Pacific, with EVO+ demand and cost discipline restoring margins. The debate is now two-sided: multiple analyst target raises (Wedbush Outperform $40, Canaccord Buy $32, Piper $33, Stifel $31) against a fresh UBS SELL at $20. With ~60% of revenue still tied to China, ~95% dependence on the ICL family, and a ~30x forward multiple on a still-recovering earnings base, the risk/reward is balanced — HOLD.

drivers: China refractive demand accelerates on conscription-season tailwinds, driving 20%+ revenue growth
Sustained return to profitability with gross margins expanding back toward historic 70%+
EVO+ rollout and disciplined cost control drive durable operating leverage
Ex-China growth (Asia-Pacific, US) diversifies the revenue base
Market awards ~30x+ P/E on restored and growing earnings power

base_case.assumptions: China stabilizes and grows modestly rather than re-accelerating; TTM revenue growth holds in the mid-single digits; profitability is sustained but earnings recover gradually; stock trades within its current range as the turnaround is proven quarter by quarter; ~30x forward multiple is broadly maintained.

risks: China economic or geopolitical shock re-cuts the ~60% revenue base
Turnaround stalls and the company slips back toward losses
Competition from LASIK/SMILE erodes ICL share and pricing
Single-product-family dependence (~95% ICL) leaves no offset if demand softens
~30x forward multiple compresses on any execution misstep

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — full results after preliminary net sales above $90M; margin and profitability confirmation
China refractive demand and military-conscription-season data — drives the ~60% revenue base and new seasonality
Margin-recovery progress — sustaining the return to profitability and rebuilding toward historic 70%+ gross margins
EVO+ rollout — next-generation ICL adoption supporting demand and mix
Ex-China growth (Asia-Pacific, US) — geographic diversification away from China concentration

key_risks: ~60% revenue concentration in China — economic and geopolitical vulnerability
Single-product-family dependence — ~95% of revenue from the ICL family
Competition from LASIK and SMILE refractive procedures
Valuation: ~30x forward earnings on a still-recovering earnings base
Turnaround is early — FY2025 posted a -$80.45M net loss and earnings recovery must be sustained
